definitions.explanation: Worrying about something that hasn't happened yet and may never happen. Borrowing trouble.

examples.japanese: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{取|と}り{越|こ}し{苦労|くろう}だ⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
{取|と}り{越|こ}し{苦労|くろう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{仕方|しかた}→仕方：01603_shikata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: There's no point in worrying about things that haven't happened.

examples.japanese: ⟦{心配|しんぱい}していた→心配する：06066_shinpaisuru⟧⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、⟦{結局|けっきょく}→結局：03815_kekkyoku⟧{取|と}り{越|こ}し{苦労|くろう}だった。
examples.english: I was worried, but in the end it turned out to be needless anxiety.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly used to reassure someone who is worrying unnecessarily, or to reflect on one's own past worries that turned out to be unfounded. Often appears as {取|と}り{越|こ}し{苦労|くろう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to worry needlessly) or {取|と}り{越|こ}し{苦労|くろう}だった (it was needless worry).

ETYMOLOGY:
From ⟦{取|と}り{越|こ}す→取り越す：22364_torikosu⟧ (to bring forward, to anticipate) + ⟦{苦労|くろう}→苦労：02672_kurou⟧ (hardship, worry). Literally "suffering brought forward" — worrying about something before it happens.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {取|と}り{越|こ}し{苦労|くろう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to worry needlessly
- {取|と}り{越|こ}し{苦労|くろう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{終|お}わる: to end up being needless worry
